references.text: Moses' unique status and prophetic role in Israel, a position that Elijah also shares.
Moses' special relationship with God, reflected in his conversation with Jesus in Mark 9:4.
Elijah's encounter with God and his prophetic role, mirrored in his appearance alongside Jesus and Moses.
The prophecy of one who will prepare the way, often associated with Elijah, linked to his appearance in Mark 9:4.
The comparison of Jesus with Moses, emphasizing the significance of their conversation in Mark 9:4.
Elijah is used as an example of the power of prayer, reflecting his importance and actions in Mark 9:4.
